registryEntry.label: Deploy iOS MAM App Protection Policy
registryEntry.set_command: $created = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceAppManagement/iosManagedAppProtections' -Body (@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.iosManagedAppProtection';displayName='CMMC-iOS-MAM';periodOfflineBeforeWipeIsEnforced='P30D';allowedDataStorageLocations=@('oneDriveForBusiness','sharePoint');dataBackupBlocked=$true;deviceComplianceRequired=$true} | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType 'application/json'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceAppManagement/iosManagedAppProtections/$($created.id)/assign" -Body (@{assignments=@(@{target=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.groupAssignmentTarget';groupId='{cuiGroupId}'}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; $created | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
